column1: # The acceptance-criterion exemptions (E11, out of the register sweep of 2026-09-15).
# EPICS.md states acceptance criteria as check boxes; TASKS.md states register rows as statuses.
# Where a criterion cites EXACTLY ONE row, the two are claims about the same thing, and
# AcceptanceCriterionChecks asserts they agree: the box is ticked if and only if the row is Done.
# 154 criteria cite exactly one row. 22 disagreed when the check was written; 17 were the documents

# lagging the work and were ticked, and the five below were the ones where disagreeing is correct. **Swept again 2026-09-15**: the E13-T12 line came out, because the client's AutoCAD import satisfied it on 2026-09-12 and the box is ticked; the E11-T16 line went in, and it is the first `Ticked` exemption here — the criterion is met while the row is not. **Then five more went in the same day**, when the check learned to read the criteria citing more than one row: that set had never been checked, and every one of the five is a real disagreement the reader had been carrying silently. A row cited as a criterion's *stated limitation* (E13-T18) or as the *gap a measurement excluded* (E2-T64) is not a row the box waits on, and two Withdrawn rows (E12-T7) are the evidence for their box rather than an obstacle to it.
# A CRITERION IS NOT ITS ROW. That is the whole reason this file exists. A criterion may be a part
# of a row, so it is met while the row is not; or broader than the row, so the row is Done and the
# criterion is not. Either way the reason is written here rather than hidden in the predicate, and
# a reason that stops being true fails the check: an exemption whose row and box now agree is a
# STALE exemption and is reported, so this file cannot become the place fixed problems go to be
# forgotten.
# KEYED ON THE CRITERION, NOT ON THE ROW, because a row can be cited by several criteria and they
# do not all need excusing - E2-T28 is cited by three and exactly one of them is here. Match must
# select exactly one criterion citing Row, or the check fails rather than guessing.
# Row       the register row the criterion cites.
# Expect    the state the box is expected to be in: Ticked or Unticked.
# Match     a distinctive substring of the criterion, which must select exactly one of them.
# Reason    why, in a sentence a stranger can check.

column4: The criterion is met and the row is Withdrawn, which is not a contradiction: IsPackable is false everywhere and no packaging metadata exists, while what D11 withdrew is the separate idea of reserving NuGet IDs. The criterion says "withdrawn" in its own text.

D29 corrected this claim on 2026-09-15: nothing greys anything, because there is no mesh-boolean node to grey and the only reader of IBrepKernel.Capabilities in the tree is the solid-file export. The flag set exists and works; what it does is make NOT claiming an operation a positive statement a provider has to make.

E2-T64 is named in this criterion's annotation as the gap the topology measurement EXCLUDED - the two Dynamo members that are pcurves rather than indices - not as a row the box waits on. Whether pcurves are deferred says nothing about whether the model is index-based with ref struct views, which is what the box claims and what E2-T22 and E2-T23 delivered.
